gloss: place of assignment; posting; department one is assigned to

definitions.gloss: place of assignment; the department or post one is assigned to
definitions.explanation: The section, branch, or location to which a new employee or transferred worker is posted. Common in corporate and bureaucratic contexts when announcing where someone will work.

examples.japanese: {配属先|はいぞくさき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
⟦{新入社員|しんにゅうしゃいん}→新入社員：15536_shinnyuushain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{配属先|はいぞくさき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The postings for the new employees were announced.

examples.japanese: ⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧{配属先|はいぞくさき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦がっかりした→がっかりする：21758_gakkarisuru⟧。
examples.english: I ended up with a different posting than I had hoped for and felt a little disappointed.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{配属|はいぞく}→配属：06159_haizoku⟧ (assignment, posting) plus the suffix ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧, which marks the destination or party on the other end of an action (as in ⟦{取引先|とりひきさき}→取引先：11083_torihikisaki⟧, a business contact).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {配属先|はいぞくさき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まる→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧: one's assignment is decided
- {配属先|はいぞくさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to request a particular posting
- {配属先|はいぞくさき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部署|ぶしょ}→部署：08187_busho⟧: the department one is assigned to

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{勤務先|きんむさき}→勤務先：08368_kinmusaki⟧: place of work — the company or office where one works, not the specific internal posting
- {出向先|しゅっこうさき}: place of secondment — where one is temporarily transferred to another organization
